# DBX MCP stdio driver
The local `dbx-mcp.exe` binary, driven over stdio JSON-RPC from PowerShell so SQL scripts can be executed straight from disk.

## Description
- Binary lives at `C:\Users\Administrator\.dbx\bin\dbx-mcp.exe` and speaks stdio JSON-RPC, so one process can initialize, open a session, begin a transaction, execute and commit without pushing SQL text through the model context.
- `dbx_execute_batch` accepts only a `sql` string and rejects `@file` references, so a 62KB generated script must be split into chunks or fed chunk by chunk.
- Sessions opened through `dbx_open_session` need `enable_transactions=true` before `begin`; batch calls route to the pinned session and `transaction_state` stays active across calls.

## Known pitfalls
- A single ~33KB batch call hung for 10+ minutes with near-zero process CPU; splitting into small chunks, or line-by-line execution with progress markers, is required.
- Statements containing Chinese stall the driver unless UTF-8 is set on the redirected stdin/stdout streams.
- A line-based RPC reader breaks when a response spans multiple lines, showing up as an apparent hang with no output.
- PowerShell `$args` is a reserved automatic variable and must not be used as a script parameter name.
- Killing the driver or its DBX child with an open transaction rolls back cleanly: on 2026-11-25 `MAX(id)` was unchanged and zero rows existed in the target range afterwards.

## Usage facts
- Validated with a probe: open session → begin → one real INSERT/UPDATE → rollback, before running the full transaction.
- On 2026-11-25 it committed 344 statements atomically (96 new zt_task rows, ids 2806–2901) for the ZenTao 2026-11-15~11-23 effort recalculation; transient routing faults succeeded on one verbatim retry.
- Temporary driver/probe scripts written to TEMP were deleted after the run and no leftover DBX processes remained.

- Ends a handoff chain only when the handoff document's unfinished/todo section is empty: all todos done means report chain termination and do not schedule the next hop, regardless of hop count or maxHops.
- On each hop reads the handoff goal, completed items, todos and constraints first, performs only the unfinished items, and never re-runs items already marked done.
- After finishing a hop updates the handoff document's verification status, cleans up temporary scripts and background processes, and states explicitly whether another hop is scheduled.
- Verifies database work from an independent connection after commit (per-day totals, precision, untouched ranges) rather than trusting the in-transaction result alone.

SET x=(SELECT ...) WHERE id BETWEEN ... AND work LIKE '提交:%'` 可行，须在事务会话内执行、提交前校验、提交后独立复核。 - 闭环标准：任务 status=done 且 zt_action 有两条记录；指派回创建人（如 huzhihao）验收，工时如实写（预计8h、消耗8h、剩余0）。 - bug 回写：UPDATE zt_bug 置 status=resolved/resolution=fixed/resolvedBy=tiany/resolvedBuild=trunk 并 INSERT 一条 resolved 动作，备注写根因、修复方案、验证数据、提交号与发布 tag；product 取 bug 自身 product；INSERT 时补 files=''、extra、read=0、efforted=0、vision='rnd' 等列；回写序列用 `zentao-resolve.mjs` 生成（`--attach` 转成 comment 内嵌 ``、并转义引号）后照抄执行，避免手拼 SQL。 ## 表与字段 - 禅道「日志」页对应 `zt_effort` 表 `work` 字段，不是 `zt_taskestimate`（工时明细表）；`zt_task.desc` 多为空，标题 `zt_task.name` 才是稳定内容来源。 - 挂附件：UPDATE `zt_file` 把 objectType 由空改为 `bug`、objectID 由 0 改为 bug 号，否则附件不显示在 bug 下。 - bug 6950 回写元数据：product=10、project=193、execution=194、openedBy=zhoudongdong。 ## 验证与实例 - 事务内复核 + COMMIT 后复核双校验：zt_bug resolved/fixed、zt_action 99120（actor=tiany、files=24229、comment 含内嵌图 has_img=1）、zt_file 24229 已挂到 bug 6950；COMMIT 返回 `transaction_state: idle`/`outcome: committed`，随后无 session 复核再 close session。 - task#2098 结论：状态 wait→done、finishedBy=tiany、消耗8h、动态 id 82385/82386。 - 涉及：C:/Users/Administrator/.dsh/skills/zentao-analyzer/zentao_fetch.py - 验证会话：bc59e190-d142-47a0-97da-97a0e446689a（基线 d0305fdb6）
